rule.leave: not head coach of the frozen team on `cut`
rule.leaveTest: log loss (clip .01-.99) vs a constant at the frozen mean Leave%, paired by coach, pass t <= -2
rule.jobsTest: movers to another frozen team: top-1 / top-3 hit of dest vs jobs drawn by frozen Leave%, 20000 draws, seed 2027, pass one-sided p < .05 on top-3
